decisions.reason: As a recent launch tied to the firm's announced expansion of compliance capabilities, with dedicated presentation and at least some positive agency-oriented feedback, management would continue it and interpret any uncertainty as temporary.

Because this platform was placed on the home page, builds directly on the core hosting business, and fits the publicly signaled agency-platform strategy, management would be especially inclined to persist with it.

This managed hosting plan is very close to the established offer and relies on existing infrastructure and service capabilities, so after investing in its launch management would be likely to retain it rather than reverse course quickly.
